analyst_view.overall: Club Brugge (9th) and Liverpool (8th) are level on 9 points, so the winner moves close to the top eight. Brugge have won their last three in Europe and won 5-1 at Mechelen on Saturday with Nicolo Tresoldi leading the line; Joel Ordonez (metatarsal) and winger Jan Virgili (groin) are out, and both are now on the numbers' list. Liverpool beat Manchester United 4-0 on Sunday; their 22-man squad confirms Gakpo (calf) and Gravenberch (heel) are out, both counted, along with Ekitike (counted), Leoni and Bradley, while Van Dijk, Isak and Wirtz lead a side with Barcola, Ngumoha and Munoz competing on the flanks. Spanish referee Alejandro Hernandez Hernandez (4.9 cards a game) is named and the numbers already add about 28% to cards for him. Since this morning's view the numbers have taken in Gakpo and Virgili themselves, so my small goals cut is gone and I stay with the numbers on every stat.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, split evenly, already up a little for both attacks' form and down for Gakpo (-8%), Gravenberch and Virgili. That was the reason for my earlier 4% cut, so it would now count twice; with Isak and Wirtz fit and Tresoldi in form, and Brugge dangerous at set pieces, I stay at 3.2.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.3 corners, 6 of them Liverpool's, and already add about 5% for Liverpool's high corner count lately. Liverpool want the ball and the width (around 20 crosses a game) and Brugge sit with one holding midfielder in Potts and break through Forbs, which fits that picture, so I stay at about 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers expect 4 cards and already add about 28% for referee Hernandez Hernandez, who averages 4.9 a game, plus 5% for Brugge's busy recent card count. There is no rivalry and nothing in the team news changes the temperature of the game, so I stay at 4.

shots.text: The numbers say 34.8 shots and have already pushed both sides up by 15-19% for their recent shooting. Gakpo's and Virgili's absences change who shoots more than how often, and Liverpool's 22 shots in the numbers rest on Isak, Wirtz and Szoboszlai, who are fit, so I stay at about 35.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.8 shots on target, already up about 9% for both sides' recent accuracy. Tresoldi is sharp for Brugge and Liverpool still have Isak and Wirtz, and the missing wide forwards are already counted, so I stay at about 11.8.
